tickets.title: Open new client account
tickets.text: Open a jointly registered taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody for Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk to receive monthly household surplus from the new joint checking arrangement, while keeping each spouse's existing retirement accounts separate.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to set up the joint taxable account, with follow-up due July 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain marriage documentation for account records
tickets.text: Collect Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk's marriage certificate and Lila's identification details and submit them to Velvet Acorn Custody so Lila can be added to jointly held account paperwork and household-level profile records.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the marriage documentation for account records by June 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete marriage-based beneficiary review
tickets.text: Review and update beneficiary designations across Rowan Bramblequill's IRA, Roth IRA, Copper Firefly Design Studio 401(k), Silver Marmot Insurance $750,000 term life policy, and employer-paid group life coverage to reflect the June 8, 2024 marriage to Lila Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete that marriage-based beneficiary review by July 17, 2024.

tickets.title: Guide benefits enrollment decision and submission
tickets.text: Use this workflow to help Rowan Bramblequill evaluate and complete the post-marriage benefits enrollment window at Copper Firefly Design Studio, comparing health, dental, vision, HSA, disability, life insurance, and payroll deduction choices against Lila Nettlewhisk's available coverage before making elections. Keep recommendations coordinated with the couple's broader financial plan, tax considerations, and combined liquidity needs.

subTasks.title: Collect benefits materials and key enrollment constraints
subTasks.text: Request the current Copper Firefly Design Studio benefits guide, plan comparison sheets, premium schedule, employer contribution details, post-marriage enrollment window, and any life event documentation needed for eligibility, including Lila Nettlewhisk's available coverage details for comparison.

subTasks.title: Review plan fit and planning tradeoffs
subTasks.text: Compare health, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, disability, life insurance, retirement plan, and payroll deduction elections for Rowan Bramblequill at Copper Firefly Design Studio against Lila Nettlewhisk's available coverage. Note cash flow impact, tax implications, beneficiary needs, and coordination with existing coverage including Rowan's $750,000 Silver Marmot Insurance term life policy.

subTasks.title: Prepare enrollment recommendations for client discussion
subTasks.text: Summarize proposed elections for Rowan Bramblequill, open questions, documents needed, and any items requiring confirmation from the Copper Firefly Design Studio benefits team or outside tax professional Sasha Cloudpuddle.

subTasks.title: Confirm submission and retain evidence
subTasks.text: After Rowan Bramblequill submits elections through the Copper Firefly Design Studio benefits portal, request confirmation pages or benefit summaries and save them to the client record for future planning reference.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to the employer benefits election review, with follow-up due July 10, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile RSU vesting records and update projections
tickets.text: Reconcile the restricted stock unit vesting cadence between Rowan Bramblequill's personal spreadsheet and the Copper Firefly Design Studio equity portal export, then update projected cash flow and tax withholding estimates for the combined household plan covering the 1,250 RSUs scheduled to vest over the next three years.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the equity vesting records by July 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Resolve custodian address and portal access issues
tickets.text: Resolve the missing address updates on recent Velvet Acorn Custody statements and ensure Lila Nettlewhisk receives the household portal invitation email before combining Rowan Bramblequill and Lila's records.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to address the custodian address and portal access issue by July 3, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate estate document updates with Paper Otter Legal Group
tickets.text: Coordinate updates to Rowan Bramblequill's will, financial power of attorney, and health care directive with Paper Otter Legal Group to reflect the June 8, 2024 marriage to Lila Nettlewhisk, the Portland townhouse and Salem condo, and the desired decision-makers for financial and health care matters.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to estate document coordination by August 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate residency and tax planning with Sasha Cloudpuddle
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Sasha Cloudpuddle on Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk's move from Portland, Oregon to Vancouver, Washington later in 2024, including mailing address, legal residence, payroll withholding, and how the Portland townhouse and Salem condo should be reflected in planning records.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to residency and tax coordination, with follow-up due July 26, 2024.
